description: T7, Common Ash: To shorten NE crown sections towards woodland footpath by 50% so they are no longer within falling distance of the footpath.  Tree is unmarked due to difficult access to base. Arrow on small Oak by footpath points to tree.Reasons - Crown sections towards woodland footpath are significantly dying back due to Ash Dieback Disease. Brittle Crown.(TPO 47)
